setup: Go Echo (go-echo-libs, port 3071), oha 5s x 64 conns, 200-row payload; real Postgres 16 (docker, localhost:5433) for DB layers

logger_recover_gzip.note: gzip per-request compression dominates the cost; logger+recover alone are near-free

post_bind_plus_go_playground_validator.note: validation adds negligible cost on the POST path

pgx_v5_pool_prepared.note: pgxpool auto-caches prepared statements; explicit prep adds nothing here

db_layers.note: sqlc generates code on top of pgx/database-sql, so its runtime cost tracks the underlying driver (~pgx numbers)
